body:
Host-contract version for this workspace's integration = generation 1.

Decision procedure (per docs/engineering/08-source-precedence-policy.md, PLMP-ALN-2):
1) Exact pinned dependency's published contract governs the interface. package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml pin @ordarium/core / @ordarium/host-kit / @ordarium/ledger-sqlite / @ordarium/testing to the ordarium-v1.3.1 release tarballs; the installed artifacts are @ordarium/core@1.3.1 and @ordarium/host-kit@1.3.1. Their shipped declarations state `HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1` (node_modules/@ordarium/core/dist/src/host.d.ts, host.js) and host-kit re-exports it. assertHostContract is exact-match and fail-closed (no tolerated mismatch / shim).
2) The normative project spec agrees: PLMP-CONF-1 (docs/engineering/13-host-adapter-conformance-spec.md §1.1) pins the assembly-time literal `assertHostContract(1)`, matching src/effects/runtime.ts:128. test/host_conformance.test.ts CONF-A01 asserts assertHostContract(1) passes and assertHostContract(2) throws HostContractMismatchError.
3) The only contrary source is docs/engineering/notes/host-contract-note.md, which claims version 2 but is explicitly self-labeled "informational, not normative". Under precedence rule 3, informational records never override the pinned published contract (rule 1) or the normative spec (rule 2); it is not a superseding authority and does not satisfy any exception. Hence it is void on this question.

Non-conflict note: the alignment log (07, r8–r19) still describes 1.2.0 pins, while package.json/pnpm overrides now use 1.3.1. That is a package-version drift only and does not change the proposition — the 1.2.0 baseline and the installed 1.3.1 both ship contract generation 1, and r10/r19 record no plan for a bump to 2. So both readings converge on generation 1.

Conclusion: this workspace's integration targets and asserts host-contract generation 1 (exact match against HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1 shipped by the pinned @ordarium/* 1.3.1 artifacts). No peer contact needed; the conflict is resolvable locally by source precedence.
